title: Aries Moon:
all about you.
summary: What Vedic astrology reads in an Aries Moon: Mars, fire, the gift and the catch, love, work, and the three birth stars inside the sign.
imageAlt: Maya holding an Aries flag, with a ram beside her
inside: Mars, fire and the movable quality, and what each is read to give you
The gift and the catch, then love, work, money and energy
The three birth stars inside Aries, in a table you can look yourself up in
Five things to do with an Aries Moon
intro: If the Moon was in Aries when you were born, Vedic astrology reads you as the one who goes first. First to speak, first to try, first to get bored of waiting. The film says that in sixty seconds. This guide takes the long way round: where that nature is said to come from, what it is good for, where it trips you up, and how the tradition tells one Aries Moon from another.

A note before you start. Everything here is what the tradition reads from the sign, said as a tendency and never as a rule. Your Moon sign is one part of a chart, and the rest of your chart, your upbringing and your own choices all shape how much of this you recognise.

sections.label: What you are made of
title: Mars, fire,
and a sign that moves.
paragraphs: Every sign has a ruler, an element and a quality. For Aries those are Mars, fire and movable. Together they explain almost everything said about the sign.
Aries is also the first of the twelve signs. The tradition reads that literally: this is the sign of beginnings, of the first step taken before the path is clear.

items.name: The ruler: Mars
items.text: Mars is the warrior among the planets: red, quick and direct. A Moon in his sign is read as a mind that meets things head on. You tend to decide fast, say it plainly and act before the feeling cools. Mars also rules Scorpio, where the same force is said to turn inward. In Aries it shows on the outside.

items.name: The element: fire
items.text: Aries, Leo and Sagittarius are the three fire signs. Fire is read as warmth, enthusiasm and appetite for life. It lights up fast and it needs something to burn, which is why an Aries Moon with nothing to do is said to be at its most restless.

items.name: The quality: movable
items.text: Signs are movable, fixed or dual. Aries is movable, along with Cancer, Libra and Capricorn. Movable signs are read as starters: they set things going and prefer change to standing still. Movable fire is the spark, where fixed fire is the hearth.

sections.label: The gift and the catch
title: Courage first,
patience later.
paragraphs: The gift is courage. Not the absence of fear, but a short gap between feeling it and moving anyway. An Aries Moon is read as the person who starts what others only talk about: sends the message, books the ticket, puts a hand up first. People tend to feel braver around you.

The catch is patience. The same speed that starts things can run out before they are finished, and waiting on other people can feel almost physical. The tradition also reads a quick temper here, with one kind detail: it is said to pass as fast as it comes. You flare, you say it, and ten minutes later you have honestly moved on. The people around you may need longer than ten minutes, and that is worth remembering.

sections.label: Love
title: You chase,
and you mean it.
paragraphs: In love an Aries Moon is said to chase. You tend to know quickly whether you are interested, and to show it without games. The tradition reads this Moon as loyal, honest and protective once it has chosen, and a little too blunt along the way.

items.name: What you bring
items.text: Directness, warmth and energy. You tend to make the first move, plan the thing, and defend the people you love without being asked. With you, a partner is rarely left guessing where they stand.

items.name: What you need
items.text: Honesty back, some room to move, and a partner with a life of their own. This Moon is said to lose interest when everything is handed over too easily, and to stay close to someone who can hold their ground kindly.

items.name: What tends to go wrong
items.text: Speed and bluntness. Saying the true thing before working out how it will land, treating a slow reply as a no, or winning an argument that did not need winning. The fix the tradition suggests is small: pause, then say the same honest thing more gently.

items.name: Work
items.text: At work an Aries Moon is read as a natural lead, especially at the start of something. You tend to do well where there is a clear target, some freedom in how to reach it, and a result you can see. Being told what to do, step by step, is not your favourite. Roles with initiative, competition, physical effort or quick decisions are said to suit this Moon better than long, slow routines.

items.name: With a boss or a team
items.text: You are said to respect people who are direct and competent, and to bristle at rules that come with no reason. It helps to ask for the goal and the deadline, then agree that the method is yours. When you lead, remember that not everyone moves at your pace.

items.name: Money
items.text: In plain terms the tradition reads this Moon as quick with money in both directions: willing to go after it, and quick to spend it on impulse or on other people. It says nothing certain about how much you will have. The habit that is said to help most is simply a pause between wanting something and buying it.

items.name: Energy
items.text: Your energy tends to come in strong bursts, not a steady flow. You are read as someone who feels better after moving: a walk, a sport, anything that uses the body. Rest is the part this Moon forgets, so plan it the way you would plan a task.

sections.label: Look yourself up
title: The three birth stars
inside Aries.
paragraphs: The sky is also divided into twenty-seven birth stars, called nakshatras, each 13°20′ wide. Three of them fall inside the thirty degrees of Aries. Which one your Moon was in is your birth star, and the tradition uses it to tell one Aries Moon from another. Each star has a ruling planet of its own, which colours the Mars and fire underneath. Your chart shows the degree of your Moon; find it in the left column.

rows.note: The horse's head, the star of the twin horsemen. Read as the quickest Aries Moon: first to arrive and first to help, light on its feet, happiest at the very start of things. The catch is restlessness and leaving before the end.

The star of bearing and carrying. Read as the most intense and creative Aries Moon: it feels deeply, enjoys beauty and pleasure, and can carry a heavy load for a long time. The catch is going to extremes and holding on too tightly.

rows.v: Krittika (first quarter), ruled by the Sun
rows.note: The flame, or the blade. Only the first quarter of this star is in Aries; the rest is in Taurus. Read as the sharpest Aries Moon: proud, direct, quick to cut to the point, and warm and protective underneath. The catch is a critical tongue.

after: If your Moon sits within a degree of one of these borders, the exact time of birth decides which side it falls on. All three are still Aries, with Mars as the sign ruler. The birth star adds a second voice, it does not replace the first.

sections.label: What to do
title: Five habits
for an Aries Moon.
paragraphs: None of this is about becoming slower or quieter. It is about giving a fast, brave nature what it needs to finish what it starts.

steps.name: Finish one thing before you start the next
steps.text: Starting is your gift, so it will always be easy. Pick the one project that matters most right now and take it all the way to done before the next idea gets your attention.

steps.name: Put a pause before the reply
steps.text: When you feel the flare, wait before you answer: one breath in a conversation, one night for a message. The tradition says your anger passes quickly. Let it pass before it speaks.

steps.name: Move every day
steps.text: Fire needs somewhere to go. Regular movement, whatever kind you enjoy, is the traditional outlet for Mars and tends to make patience easier everywhere else.

steps.name: Say the honest thing kindly
steps.text: Keep the honesty, change the delivery. Ask yourself how you would want to hear it, then say that version. Bluntness is only a problem when it costs you the listener.

steps.name: Let someone else go first sometimes
steps.text: In love and at work, leave a gap and see who steps into it. Being chased, helped or led now and then is said to be good practice for this Moon, and people often surprise you.

faq.q: Is this for my Sun sign or my Moon sign?
faq.a: Your Moon sign. Vedic astrology reads your nature and your timing from the sign the Moon was in when you were born, which is often different from the Sun sign most people know.

faq.q: I’m an Aries Sun. Does this apply to me?
faq.a: Only if your Moon is also in Aries. Many people with an Aries Sun have their Moon somewhere else, and Vedic signs are counted from the stars, so even your Sun sign may differ. Your birth chart shows your Moon sign in a few seconds.

faq.q: How do I find my birth star?
faq.a: From the degree of your Moon, which your birth chart shows. The Moon moves about thirteen degrees a day, so you need your date, place and time of birth. Draw your chart on the home page and look for the Moon’s sign and degree.

note: Sign rulers, elements, qualities and birth stars are those of the classical tradition. Vedic (sidereal) astrology, Lahiri ayanamsa, read by Moon sign.
